text: Supports building payment workflows combining wires, book transfers, and ACH credits
quote: we are going to build a basic payment workflow consisting of a wire, a book transfer, and an ACH credit

text: Open and manage FDIC-insured bank accounts programmatically, including FBO, sweep, clearing, and custom account types
quote: Programmatically open and manage FDIC insured bank accounts at Column on behalf of your customers. We support FBO, sweep, clearing and custom account types.

text: Sandbox endpoints to simulate incoming wires and ACH credits/debits for testing
quote: To simulate an incoming transfer, or just to set an initial balance on your account, you can use the `/simulate/receive-wire` endpoint. To simulate incoming ACHs, we have a `/simulate/receive-ach-credit` and a `/simulate/receive-ach-debit`

text: Issue and deposit checks programmatically via API
quote: Column provides customers the ability to issue and deposit checks through our APIs.

text: Send and receive international transfers over the SWIFT network
quote: Via our APIs, you can send and receive international transfers through the SWIFT network.

text: Send, receive, and request payments instantly via FedNow and RTP networks
quote: Column enables you to immediately send funds, receive funds, and request payment (RFP) through both the Federal Reserve's FedNow Service and The Clearing House's RTP® network.

text: Configurable webhook endpoints (via API or Dashboard) for event notifications
quote: You can configure webhook endpoints via APIs or Dashboard in your platform to be notified about events from Column.

text: Bank account transaction and summary reports available in CSV, JSON, and Parquet formats
quote: Column provides the following reports: `bank_account_transaction` and `bank_account_summary`. All reports are available in CSV, JSON, and Parquet formats.

text: Single unified endpoint to query transfers across all payment types
quote: Query transfers across all payment types from a single unified endpoint.

text: OpenAPI spec (JSON) available to generate type-safe client SDKs in any language
quote: Column's API is defined by an OpenAPI spec (also available as JSON). Use it to generate type-safe client SDKs in any language

text: Build a card program offering virtual and physical cards, working with all major networks and issuer processors
quote: Build a card program with Column to offer your customers any type of card. We work with all major networks and issuer processors.

text: Full raw message data for domestic and international wires, accessible via get wire transfer API endpoint
quote: we receive full raw data for all domestic and international wires. You can access the raw message for domestic wires using our get wire transfer API endpoint
